01

Arrival
& Parking

The Florisa Mountain Chalet is located at Weisslahn 9, 39050 Tiers, in the heart of the Dolomites. To reach the underground garage safely, please follow the steps below carefully — driving directly into the garage from the valley approach is not advised.

  • 1 Drive past the chalet approximately 100 metres up the road beyond the building.
  • 2 Turn around and approach the garage entrance from above — this is the only safe direction of entry and exit.
  • 3 Enter your access code at the keypad on the left side of the entrance. Always confirm with the checkmark (✓). A pedestrian door with the same code is available on the right.
  • 4 Select a parking space. Eight spaces are available — please use only one. To exit, press the green button to the right of the garage door.
EV Charging
Three electric vehicle charging stations are available in the underground garage. Please coordinate usage with fellow guests if spaces are occupied.
Bikes & Skis
Use the wall-mounted bike racks in the ski & bike room. Free power outlets for e-bike charging and an overnight boot dryer are provided. Keep the door closed at all times.
Daily Bread
A bread box is located near the garage entrance on the underground level. Check each morning for fresh local bread deliveries.
Cribs & High Chairs
Portable cribs with mattresses and bedding, plus high chairs for children up to three years, are stored near the underground parking level. Please collect them if not pre-arranged.
02

Access &
Your Code

Your personal access code opens every door you need — the garage, the glass door to the elevator and stairwell, and your apartment. Please do not share it with anyone outside your party.

The Grand Garden Suite is accessible directly from the garage. All other suites are reached via the stairs or elevator behind the glass door.

Your code is valid from the agreed check-in time on arrival day until check-out time on departure day.

03

Building
Layout

Underground level — Garage (8 spaces), Grand Garden Suite, Laurin Garden Suite (lower), ski & bike room, recycling room, storage, wine cellar.

Ground floor — Vajolet Garden Suite, Laurin Garden Suite (upper), outdoor whirlpool.

First floor — Family Suite.

Second floor — Penthouse Suite.

04

Your
Suite

Our spacious suites offer abundant room for relaxation and privacy. Each apartment features its own Finnish sauna, a fully equipped kitchen, and thoughtful amenities for your comfort.

Main Switch
Find the main power switch (marked by a small red light) at your apartment entrance. Turn it on upon arrival and off when you leave — the fridge and cleaning robot remain active.
Kitchen
Fully equipped. Dishwasher tablets, bags, cloths, sponge, and soap are provided. Please bring your own Nespresso capsules — we do not supply them. The dishwasher should be loaded before departure.
Robot Vacuum
Your suite includes a robot vacuum. Fill the water tank (plain water only — a capful of parquet cleaner if available), empty the waste tank, press ON. Keep all doors open for full coverage.
Climate Control
The chalet uses a geothermal heat pump with PV system — underfloor heating in winter, cooling in summer. Individual guest control is not available. The system maintains a comfortable temperature automatically.
05

Private
Finnish Sauna

Each suite is equipped with its own Finnish sauna. Indoor saunas (Grand Garden, Vajolet, Penthouse) are controlled by a rotary knob; outdoor saunas (Family, Laurin) via a digital panel. Allow 45–60 minutes to reach temperature.

The sauna switches off automatically after 2.5 hours.

Shower before entering and remove deodorant and perfume. Always sit on your sauna towel. We recommend using the sauna without swimwear. Stay hydrated — no glass containers inside. Children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult. If you have a cold, please refrain from using the sauna.
06

Outdoor
Whirlpool

The year-round heated whirlpool on the ground floor terrace offers an unrivalled view of the Dolomites. Water temperature is maintained at 28–32°C in summer and 34–36°C in winter. Jet controls are at poolside.

Operating hours run approximately 5:00 pm to 8:00 pm (starting earlier in summer). The pool fills and empties automatically. Dogs are not permitted in the outdoor area.

The sun deck, whirlpool, outdoor shower, and garden path are shared areas. The terraces and gardens of individual suites are private — please respect your neighbours.

→

The
Wine Cellar

Our private wine cellar may be reserved for special occasions and intimate celebrations. Contact us in advance to arrange your evening.

House
Guidelines

Quiet Hours
Please observe quiet hours from 10:00 pm to 7:00 am. Loud music and noisy activities are not permitted during these hours. Parties require advance written approval.
Smoking
Smoking — including e-cigarettes and vaping — is not permitted inside the building. You are welcome to smoke on your private balcony or terrace.
Waste & Recycling
South Tyrol takes recycling seriously. Plastics, glass, and paper belong in the recycling containers in the garage. General household waste and organic waste go in the bins outside the front entrance.
Photography
Personal photography is welcome. Commercial photography and filming on the premises requires our prior written consent. Please always respect the privacy of fellow guests.
Guests & Visitors
Please inform us in advance of any overnight visitors. All guests must be registered with local authorities as required by law. Maximum occupancy per suite must not be exceeded.
Pets
Pets other than dogs are not permitted. Dogs are welcome in designated suites with advance notice. A separate Dog Stay Etiquette Guide will be provided. Dogs are not allowed in the outdoor pool area.
Damages
Please treat the furnishings with care. Should any damage occur, notify us immediately via WhatsApp with a photo if possible. Guests are liable for damage caused during their stay.
Interim Cleaning
For stays of 11 days or more, interim cleaning and fresh towels are available upon request. Please contact us to arrange a convenient time.
